tagline: See how far you can travel by train from any station in China on this interactive map.
title: How far can you go by train?
intro: This map shows you how far you can travel from each train station in China within a given time.
helper: Hover your mouse over a station to see the isochrones from that city.
assumptions: Interchange time is assumed to be 20 minutes. Out-of-station travel speed is estimated at 9 km/h (between walking and biking). These are optimal travel times; actual journeys may differ.
